channel.title: 7News · Engineering
channel.description: Engineering channel: original summaries from official sources

item.title: Ollama 0.40.17 adds Inkling 2 Mini and Apple Silicon concurrency
item.description: Ollama v0.40.17 ships Thinking Machines’ Inkling 2 Mini (~26B/5.4B active) and concurrent multi-request serving on Apple silicon; Inkling is Apple-only in this release.

item.title: HyperPod Global Inference Gateway — one endpoint across clusters
item.description: AWS: SageMaker HyperPod adds a Global Inference Gateway—one SigV4 endpoint across registered clusters and Regions, scoring KV headroom, queue, proximity, and errors with automatic failover.

item.title: HyperPod Slurm adds managed extensions for observability and users
item.description: AWS: SageMaker HyperPod Slurm cluster extensions let you declare observability and user-management packages via API/console—validated, kept consistent across scale and replacement.

item.title: llama.cpp b12563 fixes CUDA expert-fallback precision; b12564 tunes Orin MMVQ
item.description: llama.cpp tagged b12563 and b12564: the former sets the per-expert dst slice to GGML_OP_MUL_MAT so requested precision is honored; the latter optimizes Orin single-column MMVQ. Path bounds and how to re-check.

item.title: Foundry Managed Compute goes GA for open-model serving
item.description: Microsoft: Foundry Managed Compute is generally available—150+ open models on dedicated GPUs (NVIDIA A100/H100/H200 or AMD MI300X), plus LoRA and BYO-weights previews.

item.title: AWS ships a distributed KV caching skill for self-hosted LLMs
item.description: AWS: an Agent Toolkit skill guides coding agents to evaluate and set up ElastiCache-backed distributed KV caching—claiming up to ~40% cost and ~80% TTFT cuts in vendor benchmarks.

item.title: SageMaker default endpoint checks: latency drift, idle GPUs, missed optimizations
item.description: SageMaker AI monitors vLLM+GPU endpoints by default for week-over-week latency/TTFT, idle GPUs, and gaps like speculative decoding off; AWS Health notifies, side-path benches, humans decide production changes.

item.title: AWS reviews 2026 SageMaker Inference launches (part 2)
item.description: AWS “SageMaker Inference 2026 launches in review, part 2” indexes year’s inference ships—not a single new API; details live in linked announcements.

item.title: SageMaker cross-region inference routing keeps serving through capacity shortfalls
item.description: SageMaker AI inference router registers existing multi-region/account endpoints as destinations; prefer local when healthy, shift new requests elsewhere on shortfalls—no capacity creation.

item.title: NVIDIA DAQIRI: high-bandwidth instrument data straight into the GPU
item.description: Holoscan acquisition library DAQIRI: Berkeley Molecular Foundry HDR EM camera >500 Gbps into GPU; adds hardware packet reorder, ~2× ibverbs throughput, and ~2–4 µs direct-polling latency.

item.title: NVIDIA on the AI infra supply chain: how manufacturing partners keep the cadence
item.description: Ops chief Deb Shoquist on partners from TSMC (since 1998) to Foxconn and Wistron; Amphenol cable cartridges ~1,500 legs at under 1 DPPM; chip-out to system-out as short as ~two weeks when demand requires.

item.title: Lambda wires 10K+ GB300 GPUs with NVIDIA Photonics CPO switches
item.description: Lambda connects GB300 NVL72 racks with NVIDIA Photonics CPO; tests cite ~4% rack and up to ~10% pod latency cuts; up to ~5× power efficiency and ~15× reliability vs pluggables (vendor).

item.title: vLLM FlyDSL MonoKernels for high-interactivity decode
item.description: vLLM’s blog explains FlyDSL MonoKernels that cut interactive decode latency on AMD Instinct by fusing dependent operator stages into single GPU launches.

item.title: SGLang ships sgl-router v0.1.0 image and PyPI wheel
item.description: The sgl-project/sglang router-v0.1.0 tag notes CI releasing the router image and PyPI wheel.

item.title: SageMaker JumpStart Model Leaderboard compares quality, speed, and cost
item.description: AWS: Studio JumpStart Model Leaderboard with AWS-run BBH, GPQA Diamond, and MMLU-Pro plus TTFT, throughput, and instance $/hr on JumpStart configs; 70+ open-weight models at launch.

item.title: SageMaker HyperPod adds workload recovery and deeper infra checks
item.description: AWS: HyperPod gains MultiNodeTrainingValidation, a Kubernetes resource monitoring agent, and Slurm hung-job detection to catch silent compute faults, stalls, and cluster-layer failures sooner.

item.title: SageMaker Serverless Model Customization adds Full Fine-Tuning
item.description: AWS adds FFT (TrainingType.FULL) to Serverless Model Customization; Qwen3-4B + 110K coding data cites ~90% LLM-as-Judge; bad LR can crater MMLU to ~3.6%.

item.title: NVIDIA Daviator batches k-points to accelerate plane-wave DFT in VASP
item.description: Daviator batches VASP k-points (including batched Davidson); mixed precision ~another 2×; claims up to ~22× vs CPU and ~75% lower cost; enable via ALCHEMI INCAR flags.

item.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory: two prompts to orchestrate physical-AI training data
item.description: CDF: five blueprints + six skills, orchestrated by a coding agent; claims up to ~60× faster dataset assembly and ~45× cheaper AV scenarios (GPU compute only).

item.title: Meta’s template-driven ML: design once against ads-ranking fragmentation
item.description: Standard Model Templates (SMT) turn ads-ranking models into composable blocks; two-year claims include ~92% less per-model eng time, 5000+ technique–model combos, ~+0.63% offline and ~+0.86% online lift.

item.title: Cloudflare open-weights Clairic and Clairic-flash for extraction on Workers AI
item.description: Clairic (~27B) and Clairic-flash (~9B) ship open weights on Hugging Face with Workers AI hosting—parallel slot generation, vendor latency tables, and promo pricing through 1 Dec 2026.

item.title: NVIDIA sparse-attention co-design — long-context cost lives in the indexer
item.description: Technical blog: trained-in sparse attention moves full scoring into the indexer—about 47% of a DeepSeek V3.2 layer at 128K prefill with Top-k. Eight GPU-friendly guidelines (KH=1, Hsz 128/256, fused Top-k, block selection).

item.title: Huawei Cloud cites IDC China government smart-cloud Leader ranking
item.description: Huawei Cloud relays IDC MarketScape China Government Smart Cloud 2026: Leader quadrant, #1 on share and capability (claimed); Agentic Cloud cites ~30%→70% utilization and ~50%→85% retrieval precision.

item.title: Huawei Cloud open-sources Ascend-native CloudRobo-WM1.2 embodied world model
item.description: “Industry AI Dream Factory” open-sources Ascend-native CloudRobo-WM1.2: shared backbone + DualAct; claims #1 on RoboTwin 2.0 and LiberoPro 2.0; five core techniques and four inference modes.

item.title: Azure × Oracle: agents on core business data and Work IQ context
item.description: Ignite: agents span Oracle systems of record and Microsoft Work IQ; Excel plug-in and Copilot entry points; Database@Azure in 33 regions; Workload Center limited preview + managed MCP.

item.title: Azure Catalyst and Ignite infra—Foundry + AKS as the agent run axis
item.description: Ignite: isolated sandboxes, Agent Grid, context reuse, AKS AI Manager; Catalyst agents for app/data modernization (1.4M apps claimed); Foundry↔AKS path for open models.

item.title: vLLM v0.34.0 defaults to extensible KV and Model Runner V2 only
item.description: vLLM v0.34.0 turns on extensible KV by default, removes Model Runner V1, and moves default block-size to 64. How post-warmup free-memory sizing works, the throughput vs TPOT trade-off, and what to change before you upgrade.

item.title: Vercel Sandbox Python SDK hits 1.0 with TypeScript parity
item.description: Vercel Changelog: Sandbox Python SDK 1.0 stabilizes the public API and matches the TypeScript SDK; context managers, AnyIO async; 0.x upgrades include bytes I/O breaking changes.

item.title: Vercel AI Gateway adds Private Inference for your own endpoints
item.description: Vercel Changelog: fine-tuned, self-hosted, or prerelease models share Gateway auth, SDKs, and observability via private/… IDs; optional catalog fallback; CLI 65.16.0+.

item.title: Ollama + Together: open models for long-horizon agents via prefix cache
item.description: Ollama and Together AI co-author a post on agent traffic with large inputs and tiny tool-call outputs—and how to keep prefix caches intact across harness and inference.

item.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 leads provisional MLPerf Endpoints v1.0
item.description: NVIDIA Technical Blog: provisional MLPerf Endpoints v1.0 shows Vera Rubin NVL72 at roughly 5×–10× throughput per kW vs verified GB300 NVL72 at shared minimum E2E interactivity; Rubin pending MLCommons review.

item.title: NVIDIA announces Rubin HPC at SC26 for simulation and agent feedback loops
item.description: At SC26, Rubin HPC joins the Vera Rubin platform with 50,000+ CUDA cores, sparse-data acceleration, and 7th-gen NVLink—aimed at science/engineering sims and agent-driven hypothesis–simulate–refine loops, expected in 2028.

item.title: NVIDIA: serve GLM-5.3 NVFP4 across two DGX Stations with vLLM TP
item.description: 753B MoE (~464 GB) will not fit one GB300 (252 GB HBM3e); ConnectX-8 RDMA + vLLM TP=2; AIPerf ~607.8 tok/s at concurrency 16, ~385 at 32.

item.title: NVIDIA cuPhoton.xBeam: GPU-accelerated black-hole interferometry correlation
item.description: cuPhoton.xBeam correlates VLBI/EHT voltages on GPUs; Vera Rubin NVL72 with 64 GPUs processes 10 TB in ~70 s—~460× vs an x86 baseline; read BW up to ~170 GB/s.

item.title: NVIDIA: native DLA inference in Python on Jetson AGX Orin via cuDLA
item.description: cuda.bindings.cudla (≥13.3.0) exposes cuDLA to Python; CUDA_DLA hybrid mode sequences GPU pre/post and DLA on one stream; same API on RTX Spark.

item.title: Cloudflare: a Modern Security Model against AI pentest orchestrators
item.description: Cloudflare saw 50+ LLM pentest orchestrator families scan customers in three days; ARTEX takedown spawned forks; recommends a six-pillar Modern Security Model (WAF, bot, identity-gated access).

item.title: vLLM on TPU v7: 0.6B dense RL cycle ~100 min → ~56 s
item.description: Meta ASA + open TPU stack: Qwen3-0.6B GRPO on 64-chip TPU v7 hits ~56 s rollout-to-update (~183K tok/s), ~107× vs untuned; changes upstreamed.

item.title: vLLM-Omni day-0 for MiniMax H3-Image: 4K in 0.87s on Vera Rubin
item.description: vLLM: H3-Image hits 0.87s median native 4K on four Vera Rubin GPUs in a short prompt bench; another config ~6,115 images/hour across multi-vendor hardware.

item.title: vLLM day-0 for Inkling 2 Small: 594B MoE, mixed precision, DSpark
item.description: vLLM adds Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Small (~594B total / 17B active, 1M context) on day 0 with NVFP4+MXFP8 MoE and native DSpark; up to ~630 TPS/user on GB200 TP4.

item.title: vLLM: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Vera Rubin vs GB300 NVL72
item.description: Part three of vLLM’s DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash series moves the stack to Vera Rubin NVL72, citing ~58× throughput vs GB300 under AgentX with P/D and Wide-EP.
